## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from and targeting `main`
- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat(...)`, `fix(...)`, ...)
- [ ] `npx vite build` / `mvn verify` pass for what I touched
- [ ] Screenshot attached (UI changes)
- [ ] `docs/features.md` updated (user-facing features)
